description: Defines the LogFileIterator class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used to iterate over CloudTrail log files stored in Amazon S3. Implements log file listing with filtering options based on date ranges, prefixes, and regex matching.

classes.name: LogFileIterator
classes.description: An iterator over CloudTrail S3 log files, supporting filtering by date, prefix, and regex, with methods for constructing iterators based on AWS CloudTrail trail configurations.

methods.name: forTrail
methods.description: Factory method to create a LogFileIterator for a specific trail, retrieving the S3 bucket name and prefix from CloudTrail.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the iterator with specific S3 client, bucket name, and filtering options.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current object as an array containing the Bucket and Key of the log file.

methods.name: buildListObjectsIterator
methods.description: Constructs an iterator to list S3 objects based on specified filtering options, including date ranges and prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeDateValue
methods.description: Converts various date formats into unix timestamps.

methods.name: determineDateForPrefix
methods.description: Generates a date string for the prefix based on start and end dates.

methods.name: applyRegexFilter
methods.description: Filters S3 objects using regex matching based on log file prefixes.

methods.name: applyDateFilter
methods.description: Filters S3 objects to match specified date ranges based on filenames.
